title: Artimus and old laces
brief_description: An important concept, the distributive principle, is illustrated in this animated tale about the multiplication problems of Cyrus Squeeze, tax collector. His niece Louise helps out by picturing each problem as areas or rectangular arrays, which she then adds up for the final product. No other credits available.
